_source: Amyloidosis_MultiPhenotype_Bucket_Config.xlsx, Temporal Rules sheet (T01-T07). Excel columns preserved verbatim; machine fields retained for SQL wiring.
_schema_gap: T02, T04, T05, and T06 all require detecting PERSISTENCE or PROGRESSION across multiple visits/dates for the same atom (e.g. 'repeated CRP elevation', not one CRP value). But ATTR_V3_ATOMS as designed in 10_architecture_mechanics_and_new_tables.md only carries <atom_id> and <atom_id>_FIRST_SEEN — a single earliest date, no occurrence count and no last-seen date. These four rules cannot actually be evaluated until ATTR_V3_ATOMS gains either <atom_id>_OCCURRENCE_COUNT or <atom_id>_LAST_SEEN. They are written below with the correct atom/bucket references, but marked 'executable: false' until that schema extension happens — do not wire them into SQL as-is.

rules.logic: First qualifying ORTHO evidence precedes first qualifying CARDIO evidence
rules.threshold_status: No hard minimum gap; store years_between for ranking/explanation
rules.double_counting_guardrail: Do not create an extra bucket.

rules.logic: Evidence of progression across visits/tests rather than one lifetime neuropathy code
rules.threshold_status: Use first/last date and repeated objective findings when available
rules.double_counting_guardrail: Progression is part of phenotype quality.
rules.requires_schema: ATTR_V3_ATOMS.<atom_id>_OCCURRENCE_COUNT or _LAST_SEEN — not yet designed. See _schema_gap above.

rules.logic: Known carrier/family-risk context precedes a new objective neurologic/autonomic/renal change
rules.double_counting_guardrail: Do not call active ATTRv from genotype alone.

rules.logic: Repeated/persistent activity over time rather than one CRP/ESR/SAA value
rules.threshold_status: No universal hard threshold in this config
rules.double_counting_guardrail: Inflammatory activity is a modifier, not the second independent disease bucket.
rules.requires_schema: ATTR_V3_ATOMS.<atom_id>_OCCURRENCE_COUNT or _LAST_SEEN — not yet designed. See _schema_gap above.

rules.logic: New/persistent or progressive renal abnormality after/with chronic inflammatory driver
rules.threshold_status: Require persistence/trend where source row specifies it
rules.double_counting_guardrail: Single transient abnormality should not trigger the gate.
rules.requires_schema: ATTR_V3_ATOMS.<atom_id>_OCCURRENCE_COUNT or _LAST_SEEN — not yet designed. See _schema_gap above.
ATTR_V3_ATOMS.<atom_id>_OCCURRENCE_COUNT or _LAST_SEEN — not yet designed. See _schema_gap above.

rules.double_counting_guardrail: Count distinct organ buckets, not repeated codes.
rules.requires_schema: ATTR_V3_BUCKET_TIER.FIRST_SEEN_DATE (already in the Layer 3 design) — this rule is the composite AL21's own temporal counterpart; see 02b_composite_rules.md.
